description: This file defines a React functional component 'Integrations' that manages third-party service integrations (Stripe and QuickBooks). It includes UI rendering, state management, and API calls for connecting, disconnecting, and fetching integration status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches current connection status for Stripe and QuickBooks and updates component state.

methods.name: handleConnect
methods.description: Handles the connection process for a given provider, initiating API calls and managing redirection.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection process for a provider via API calls and refreshes status.
